card.name: Infusion schedule days and durations
card.fires_on: Words and numbers in chemotherapy dosing schedules, such as the day number after "Days", the digit of an infusion time, or "doses" and "weeks" in a regimen.

modes.label: Day numbers
modes.description: The first number or the word Days in a list of treatment days within a cycle.
modes.example: on Days <<1>> and 8 Subsequent Occurrence If

modes.label: Infusion duration
modes.description: The first digit of a number of minutes for an infusion.
modes.example: intravenous infusion over <<1>>0 minutes administered after pembrolizum

modes.label: Regimen wording
modes.description: Nouns describing later doses or the interval between them.
